automatic.baseline: repository-selected Git merge base; committed checks use committed policy and objects
automatic.coverage: Rust allow/expect attributes, including inactive cfg branches and literal macro output
automatic.enrollment: no-new findings immediately; per-touch paydown after policy reaches comparison baseline
automatic.exceptions: explained allowances still require compiler, feature and clippy checks
automatic.noNew: finding identity counts cannot increase or trade one violation for another
automatic.paydown: each touched crate with baseline debt removes at least one finding
automatic.rationale: nonempty literal reason string; meaning requires review
automatic.scopeTransfer: matching parsed rule/scope/attribute debt moved into changed excluded source is not paydown; unrelated additions and unparseable excluded fixtures remain outside enforcement
automatic.strict: explicit directory binding requires zero findings and cannot silently weaken

review.authority: receiving repository chooses scope and provenance; discovery never grants standing or executes code
review.guide: applies as reviewed developer guidance beyond automated rule coverage
review.limits: no automatic semantic proof of reasons, Cargo/CLI suppressions, API quality or upstream ownership
review.rationale: human or explicitly delegated review assesses necessity, narrowness and meaningful reasons
